name: Youth WORK in Trades (Richmond SD38)
what_you_do: Get paid work in a SkilledTradesBC trade and earn high school credit for it. Your work hours count toward an apprenticeship.
who_can_apply: Students ages 15 to 19 who have a job in a known trade. A skilled worker called a journeyperson must agree to sponsor you.
pay_detail: Paid by the employer. Rate not stated. Finishing may earn a $1,000 scholarship from the Ministry of Education and Child Care.
duration: 120 paid work hours plus 3 short online assignments per course, up to 4 courses (16 credits)
how_to_apply: Contact the district coordinator by the email or phone on the page.
notes: Contact Peter Thackwray, pthackwray@sd38.bc.ca, 604-668-6000 ext 1463. Courses are taken off the timetable. You need a trades employer first. Written for Richmond students.
